title: FLRT: FLUENT STUDENT-TEACHER REDTEAMING
reasoning: The paper describes a method (FLRT) for generating fluent adversarial attacks to jailbreak safety-tuned LLMs. Although it evaluates the models' refusal of 'toxic' or 'unethical' requests (such as instructions for illegal activities or self-harm), the work is centered on the cybersecurity and optimization aspect of redteaming rather than benchmarking religion, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks.
